latest_release.name: Strata 0.2.15
latest_release.body:
# Strata 0.2.15: fixes in the app and the Terminal

The app and the Terminal are 0.2.15. Control is 0.1.61. The engines stay at 0.1.60: the same files as in 0.2.14, which the update feed downloads from the 0.2.14 release. The update feed is sequence 127.
The Intel Arc engine and the DGX Spark engine stay at 0.1.59; the DGX Spark keeps its update feed (sequence 123).

## What changes for you

- Nothing to do. Update as usual (see Updating below). Your models, chats and settings stay.
- The engine is not downloaded again: `strata update` and the app replace the app and the Terminal only.
- There are no new settings.

## Fixed

**The app**
- **The app no longer starts llama.cpp's llama-server.** In 0.2.14 a model added with "Use a local GGUF…" could load through a llama-server program found on the PC (in `STRATA_LLAMA_SERVER`, on PATH, or in /opt/homebrew/bin or /usr/local/bin), and the app loaded it again by itself at its next start. Strata now loads models only on its own engine. Such a model shows: "Strata runs models only on its own engine, so this model can't load here. Open Models and choose a model there, or use "Use a local GGUF…" for a file you already have." Checked on the packaged Linux app with a stand-in llama-server named in `STRATA_LLAMA_SERVER` and first on PATH: 0.2.14 started it after Load (1 start); 0.2.15 started it 0 times, at Load and at its next start.
- **Drafting Off in the app no longer downloads the draft layer.** In 0.2.14 the app's install asked for the MTP draft layer (about 5 GB) even with Drafting set to Off, on a Mac too. (Checked by the app's tests; not timed on a PC.)
- **A Drafting choice made on the app's Models screen is kept after the app restarts.** In 0.2.14 the app saved the choice at the start of a Load and wrote the model's settings back without it once the model was ready. After a restart the Models screen showed "Auto (recommended)", and a model set to Off loaded with the DFlash2 drafter. On a Linux PC (Tesla P100, IQ3_XXS) with no MTP draft layer on disk, each choice was made, loaded, and loaded again after an app restart: Off (no drafter, ready in 104 s after the restart), DFlash2 (113 s) and MTP (116 s); the Models screen showed the choice each time.
- **The app's note "There is no internet connection, so the draft layer can't be downloaded now" appears only when the model starts without a drafter.** In 0.2.14 it could stay on screen after a drafter had been found or downloaded.
- **Qwen3.6 35B-A3B on a first run.** On a clean Linux PC (2x RTX A6000, 77 MB/s), the first-run install of UD-Q4_K_XL downloaded 23.75 GB and finished in 320 to 340 s, and the bar never stood at 99%. In 0.2.14 this install stopped after 4 seconds.
  - The download no longer stops with "this engine (99.0.0) does not run Qwen3.6-35B-A3B yet" while the engine is still being downloaded beside it, and a failed install no longer cancels the engine download.
  - Pictures stay on: with no engine on the PC yet, the app now installs the engine first and then the model, so the picture reader (`mmproj-F16.gguf`, 899,283,584 B) is downloaded with it. On the same PC the install took 350 s, the model loaded with pictures on, and a picture of a red square was answered "It is a red square." (the picture reader started in 0.8 s, using 1,325 MiB of graphics memory).
  - The progress bar no longer stops at 99% after the last file. It reaches 100% when every file is in. While the 22.85 GB model file is checked, the bar shows that check ("Preparing files…") instead of a download figure.
  - The picture reader's part of the bar counts what has arrived. In 0.2.14 it showed 98 to 99% when 16 to 48% of it had arrived.
  - When every file is in but the engine for the PC is not ready, the setup screen now says so: "Your model is downloaded, but the engine for this PC isn't ready yet. Open Settings > About to install it."

Run powerful AI on your own computer.

Chat, code and work with images, locally.

Models · Install · Hardware · Tools · Help · Support

English · 简体中文 · 日本語 · Deutsch · Français · Español · Português · Polski

**Free, open source, and yours to run.** Use Strata on your desktop or with your favorite coding tools. No account needed. ## Models We recommend **ISTA-DASLab first**, then **Unsloth** and other providers, where a compatible model fits.
 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next | Provider | Choices | | --- | --- | | **ISTA-DASLab · recommended** | Q2\_0, IQ2\_XS, IQ3\_XXS, IQ3\_S. [Coder: IQ1\_M](docs/MODELS.md#coder) for coding. | | **Unsloth** | UD-IQ4\_XS, UD-Q4\_K\_XL, UD-Q5\_K\_XL, UD-Q6\_K\_XL, Q8\_0 | | **Gyro · agentionai** | [Gyro-S, Gyro-M](https://huggingface.co/agentionai/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Gyro-GGUF). Lower memory use but slower. | | **Other options** | [Swift 1.5](docs/MODELS.md#swift-15), [NVFP4](docs/NVFP4.md), [OrcaRouter](docs/ORCA.md) | [Compare sizes, memory needs and compatibility](docs/MODELS.md).
 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B **Unsloth:** UD-Q4_K_XL, UD-Q6_K_XL, Q8_0. These are the currently documented packs for this model. [Model guide and compatibility](docs/QWEN36.md).
Not sure what fits? [Choose a model for your computer](docs/MODELS.md#pick-by-memory). ## Install ### Desktop app **[Download Strata for Windows, Linux or Mac →](https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/releases/latest)** Install the app, choose a model, and start chatting. There is one installer for each system. On first start the app downloads the engine for your graphics card. [Help with the installer](docs/INSTALL.md#the-app). Files: `Strata-0.2.16-windows-x64-setup.exe` · `Strata-0.2.16-linux-x86_64.AppImage` · `Strata-0.2.16-macos-arm64.dmg`


Chat, files and a live preview in one window.

### Terminal app Prefer the terminal? Install Strata, then run **`strata launch`**.
Install commands **Linux / Mac** ```sh curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 120 https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/releases/latest/download/install.sh -o install.sh && sh install.sh ``` **Windows PowerShell** ```powershell irm -TimeoutSec 120 https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/releases/latest/download/install.ps1 | iex ``` On Windows, open a new terminal afterwards. Then: ```sh strata launch ``` Follow the prompts to download and start a model. [Terminal guide](docs/TERMINAL_LAUNCH.md).


Watch your model and hardware while it runs.

[Build from source](docs/SOURCE_INSTALL.md) · [Docker](docs/DOCKER.md) · [Full install guide](docs/INSTALL.md) ## Hardware | Supported hardware | Guide | | --- | --- | | **NVIDIA GeForce RTX 20 / 30 / 40 / 50 series** | [NVIDIA setup](docs/INSTALL.md#what-you-need) | | **AMD Radeon RX 7700 / 7800 / 7900, RX 9060 / 9070, AI PRO R9700** | [AMD setup](docs/AMD_HIP.md) | | **AMD Radeon RX 6800 / 6900 · experimental** | [RX 6000 setup](docs/AMD_HIP.md#rdna2-gfx1030) | | **Intel Arc · Linux** | [Intel setup](docs/INTEL_ARC.md) | | **Apple Silicon · M1 or newer** | [Mac setup](docs/MAC.md) | | **AMD Ryzen AI Max · Strix Halo** | [Strix Halo setup](docs/STRIX_HALO.md) | | **NVIDIA DGX Spark · Linux** | [DGX Spark setup](docs/DGX_SPARK_LINUX.md) | ## Tools **Claude Code · Codex CLI · OpenCode · oh-my-pi · pi.dev · Hermes Agent · OpenClaw**, and more through the OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs. Run **`strata connect`** to see setup instructions for your tool. [Connection guide](docs/TERMINAL_LAUNCH.md#connect-your-apps-strata-connect). ## Help [All guides](docs) · [Troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md) · [Report a bug](https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/issues/new/choose) · [Benchmarks](docs/COMMUNITY_BENCHMARKS.md) · [How it works](docs/HOW_IT_WORKS.md) · [Contribute](.github/CONTRIBUTING.md) ## Support Strata **Help keep local AI open to everyone.** A GitHub sponsorship or a coffee helps fund development and testing on more hardware. ### Loyal supporters Thank you to everyone who supports Strata. All supporters and how to support Strata: [SUPPORTERS.md](SUPPORTERS.md) [MIT license](LICENSE) · [Credits and model licenses](docs/HOW_IT_WORKS.md#credits) · [Privacy](docs/SAFETY.md) For AI tools and automated readers: technical reference · setup instructions. **Sponsorships, hardware partnerships or collaborations:** [niko.veit@outlook.com](mailto:niko.veit@outlook.com).
